name: Gift Giving
overview: Scripture reveals that all gifts originate from God, who empowers us to acquire and share blessings as part of His covenant faithfulness (Deuteronomy 8:18). Giving is both an act of worship and a means of grace, exemplified by the Magi presenting valuable gifts to Christ (Matthew 2:11) and the call to bring tithes faithfully to God’s storehouse, promising abundant blessings in return (Malachi 3:10). The principle of generosity is underscored by Jesus’ teaching that giving results in receiving abundantly (Luke 6:38), reflecting God’s ultimate gift of His Son for our salvation (John 3:16). Additionally, gifts can open doors and favor before others when given wisely (Proverbs 18:16).
